content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired PD-2345: P1 - inference-hosting-eu high 5xx rate detected (threshold 0.5% -> observed 4.2%). Automated page to on-call.

sam: seeing same in grafana. spike started ~02:03 UTC. This is affecting hosted API region eu-central-1.

kevin: I'm oncall, grabbing it. starting runbook check: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/inference-5xx

maria: adding customer-impact note: multiple customer calls reporting failed completions, frontend retries visible.

pri: logs show 503 from model-proxy behind dedicated pool, increased queue length on pool-gpu-07. snippet: `queue_len: 114 -> 720`

kevin: ack. taking ownership. @sam can you open a quick bridge? 

sam: bridge open https://zoom.company/bridge-1791239876 - adding runbook steps in case we need a rollback.

pagerbot: PD-2345 acknowledged by kevin (on-call). Escalation suppressed.

kevin: first mitigation attempt: draining pool-gpu-07, redirecting new requests to pool-gpu-03 (same model version). Applying routing rule now.

maria: confirmed routing change propagated to edge routers within ~45s. 5xx rate dropping to 2.1% but still above threshold.

pri: also observed increased model load due to a specific customer job with long context lengths. Flagging job id: job_0xA1F3 (rate-limited now).

kevin: paused that job via admin API `POST /admin/jobs/job_0xA1F3/pause` — response 200. Monitoring for another 2m.

sam: dashboards show 5xx at 0.9% now. latency for small requests stable. Customer-facing retries reduced.

maria: started drafting external blurb for customers (short PSA) — will share once we confirm stable for 10m.

kevin: continuing to monitor, will hand back to rotation if stable. tagging runbook step completed: kernel fallback, drain, job pause.

incident-bot: PD-2345 status update: acknowledged (kevin) | mitigation in progress | next update in 5m.

sam: one more quick note — setting a temp alert suppression for similar pages while we validate to avoid noisy duplicates.

kevin: thanks team. I'll post final update in 8m or when fully resolved.

pri: thanks — tracked in incident board: https://redwood-ops/incidents/PD-2345
